statement:
by
  classical
  let primes := fun N q a : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%q=a)
  let dense := fun (A : Set ℕ) (d a : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ T, (t-ε)*((primes N d a).card:ℝ) ≤ (((primes N d a).filter (fun p => p ∈ A)).card:ℝ)
  exact ∀ A B : Set ℕ, (∀ p ∈ A, Nat.Prime p) → (∀ p ∈ B, Nat.Prime p) →
    ∀ W b : ℕ, 0 < W → b < W → (∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ d : ℕ, 0 < d → 2*W ∣ d → ∀ r : ℕ, r < d → Even r → r%W=b →
      ∃ a c : ℕ, a < d ∧ c < d ∧ a.Coprime d ∧ c.Coprime d ∧ (a+c)%d=r ∧ ∃ u v : ℝ, 0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧ v ≤ 1 ∧ 1+δ ≤ u+v ∧ dense A d a u ∧ dense B d c v) →
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ T, (((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ n%W=b ∧ ¬∃ p ∈ A, ∃ q ∈ B, p+q=n)).card:ℝ) ≤ η*(X:ℝ)/(W:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 允许两套不同的素数子集，仅要求每个目标细分类有一对密度和超过 1 的相容加数类。
plain_statement.en: Almost-all binary Goldbach for two prime subsets with target-dependent compatible local densities.

brief.zh: Alsetri–Shao 定理 1.2 对同一集合在每个既约类都要求超过半密度。本题可在部分加数类完全缺失时使用，只要每个目标细分类仍有一对有固定盈余的类。取 W=1、A=B 且所有类统一超过一半就恢复原定理。可用 #4281 的双输入转移定理逐类组装。
brief.en: Theorem 1.2 uses one set uniformly above half in all reduced classes. Here entire summand classes may be absent if each target refinement has a compatible pair with uniform surplus. Set W=1 and A=B to recover the original hypothesis as a sufficient condition. Apply the two-input transfer of #4281 on each compatible pair.
